result.rationale: Alto is the federal Crown corporation VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc., wholly owned by VIA Rail, not a CDPQ portfolio company. CDPQ Infra is lead/equity member of the separate Projet Cadence Rail s.e.c. developer vehicle. The March 2025 PDA is co-development, not an Alto equity purchase or closed concession; 2026 procurement still preceded Canada's final investment decision.

identityResolution.type: Federal agent Crown corporation/public project office; Alto also brands the network.
identityResolution.distinction: Cadence=private developer; Projet Cadence Rail s.e.c.=developer vehicle; CDPQ Infra=vehicle lead/equity member, not Alto owner.

ownershipResolution.altoOwner: VIA Rail Canada Inc. (100%); Alto is an agent of the Crown.
ownershipResolution.conclusion: No CDPQ/CDPQ Infra equity in Alto or signed purchase of Alto shares/assets was found. Later capital, concession or asset ownership is conditional and NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

operatingResolution.phase: PDA co-development, route/design/environmental/land work and early procurement; alignment and federal final investment decision remained outstanding in 2026.
operatingResolution.scale: Approximately 1,000 km of dedicated electrified HSR; Ottawa–Montréal is the first segment.

acquisitionExitCheck.finding: No public Alto share transfer/acquisition, asset or concession financial close, sale, exit, cancellation, merger, recapitalization or bankruptcy was found. The 2025-03-19 PDA is non-ownership; June 2026 sources still placed procurement before Canada's final investment decision.

milestones.event: VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc. incorporated as VIA Rail's wholly owned subsidiary.

Alto and Cadence signed the PDA and began co-development.
Cadence launched early-procurement market engagement; federal final investment decision remained future.
